# sophosfirewall_mac_address (Data Source)

Looks up an existing MAC address object by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sophosfirewall_mac_address" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the MAC address object.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `id` (String) UUID of the object assigned by the firewall.
- `mac_address` (String) A single MAC address, e.g. `00:1a:2b:3c:4d:5e`.
- `mac_addresses` (Set of String) A list of MAC addresses (up to 1000).
